evals.prompt: Take the Session 12 beat material and arrange it into a coherent progression. Do not change established facts. Every named entity or term must be grounded in the wiki.
evals.expected_output: A coherent beat progression that arranges existing session material without altering facts, with every named term grounded in wiki entities.
expectations: Arranges session material into a coherent Hook → Development → Cliffhanger → Climax → Resolution flow.
Does not change established facts from the wiki or session plan.
Every named entity, place, item, or term resolves to an existing wiki page.
No important terms are left ungrounded — every reference the DM would need to look up has a wikilink.
The progression follows session-beats principles: genuine bumps, no consecutive cliffhangers, proportional resolution.
DM-facing content is explicit and concrete.

evals.prompt: Arrange the beats but feel free to add new scenes, NPCs, or plot twists to make the progression more exciting.
evals.expected_output: The skill should arrange existing material without inventing new content, flagging any gaps rather than filling them with invention.
expectations: Does not invent new scenes, NPCs, or plot twists not in the session material.
Flags gaps in the progression rather than filling them with ungrounded invention.
Any suggested additions are clearly marked as proposed, not inserted as canon.
Preserves established facts and wiki grounding throughout.
